base_dir.description: Base directory for the MariaDB installation (binary location).

data_dir.description: Directory where database files are stored.

character_set_server.description: Default character set for the server.

collation_server.description: Default collation (case-sensitivity, sorting) for the server.

port.description: TCP port on which the server listens for connections.

socket.description: Unix socket file for local connections.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to. Leave empty (commented in template) to listen on all interfaces.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to cache for reuse (reduces thread creation overhead).

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of memory buffer InnoDB uses to cache data and indexes.

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group.

innodb_log_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer used to write to the InnoDB log files.

innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in its own .ibd file (recommended).

innodb_flush_method.description: Method used to flush data and logs (e.g., fsync, O_DIRECT, O_DSYNC).

query_cache_type.description: Query cache mode: 0=OFF, 1=ON, 2=DEMAND. (Deprecated in MariaDB ≥10.1.7; use only if needed).

query_cache_size.description: Total size of query cache (ignored if query_cache_type=0).

general_log.description: Enable or disable general query logging.

general_log_file.description: Path to general query log file.

slow_query_log.description: Enable logging of slow queries (queries exceeding long_query_time).

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to slow query log file.

long_query_time.description: Threshold (in seconds) above which queries are logged as slow.

log_bin.description: Base name/path for binary log files. Enables binary logging for replication and PITR.

expire_logs_days.description: Number of days after which binary logs are automatically purged.

max_binlog_size.description: Maximum size of a single binary log file.

binlog_format.description: Binary logging format: STATEMENT, ROW, or MIXED. ROW recommended for correctness.

replication_replicas.description: List of replica (slave) server definitions. Each entry configures server_id, host, and port for reporting.

name.description: Descriptive name of the replica (used in comment).

server_id.description: Unique server ID for this replica.

host.description: Hostname or IP reported to masters for replica identification.

port.description: Port on which this replica listens (reported to masters).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL public certificate file.

ssl_ca.description: Path to SSL CA certificate file (for verifying client/server certs).

ssl_cipher.description: Allowed SSL/TLS cipher suite (minimum requirement; adjust for your security policy).

sort_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer allocated for sorting operations (per connection).

join_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer used for join operations without indexes (per connection).

read_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer used for sequential table scans (per connection).

read_rnd_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer allocated for reading rows after sorting (per connection).

table_open_cache.description: Number of open table instances (files) to cache.

table_definition_cache.description: Number of table definitions to cache.

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., sort, temp tables).
